note: The chrome every realm inherits: the rail, the command bar, the masthead, the account panel, the tray, and the six request states async.js owns. A realm registers its OWN states in its own file — this one is Part 0's, and it is the seed the catalogue grows from. `flags` are harness stub flags (stub.js reads fail/slow/offline/today/owner/realms/admin/category/destroy/draft/id/ids/mode/q/scope — there is no ?empty=; an empty state is reached by narrowing).

states.name: slow request
states.note: walked WHILE the request is still out — the skeleton and the is-slow note are the state

states.name: the door · signed out
states.note: the only surface a signed-out person reaches; it must not imply the app is open behind it

states.name: the door · not an admin
states.note: spec §10 — a stranger, a never-granted account and a revoked admin all read identically; forbidden adds ONE line
